description_sq:
Ofrohet per shitje apartament 2+1+2 ne Astir prane bar Return.

Per me shume informacion apo nje vizite ne prone me kontaktoni !!
description_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale in Astir near the Return bar. The area in which it is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life. The apartment is organized in a corridor which divides the living room together with the kitchen, 2 bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2 balconies. The apartment is located on the second residential floor, it is offered empty and is part of a relatively new building with an elevator. Has regular mortgage documentation. For more information or a visit to the property, contact me!!
